custom_logic_notes: CCFp EA uses the Composite Currency Framework percentage indicator to calculate relative strength of 8 major currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, AUD, CAD, NZD). It ranks currency pairs by strength differential - buying the strongest currency against the weakest. The CCFp indicator is a custom indicator that must be available in the Indicators folder. The EA analyzes multiple currency pairs simultaneously to find the best strength divergence. Exact parameters (SL, TP, lots, thresholds) could not be extracted due to binary file read failure.
python_conversion_notes: The CCFp custom indicator logic must be reimplemented in Python since it is not a built-in MT5 indicator. The indicator computes currency strength from multiple currency pair data (28 pairs for 8 currencies). Python implementation would need to: (1) fetch OHLC data for all 28 major pairs, (2) compute normalized strength for each of 8 currencies using the CCFp algorithm, (3) rank pairs by strength differential, (4) generate entry/exit signals based on strength crossovers. The multi-pair data dependency makes this significantly more complex than single-pair EAs.
